prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1389; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment grew to many times the usual amount for this injury, with near-daily visits and new body areas added weeks after the crash.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a reported wrist fracture. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the force described, and the findings fit the reported impact. Radiographs and the physical examination clearly confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to this area is documented in the available history. Treatment has been intensive, with 29 visits to date, most occurring on a near-daily basis. Over the course of care, the patient reported symptoms in additional body regions, first noted several weeks after the collision. The visit frequency and the number of treated areas are well above what is typically expected for an uncomplicated fracture of this type. Billing records reviewed to date show no duplicate or repeated charges. Ongoing management includes immobilization, range-of-motion monitoring, and a reassessment of the wrist and the newly reported areas at the next scheduled visit.
